messages:
tay: Opening PR to tighten docs for fallback behavior on transient 429s/timeouts. Need a tiny recommended pattern + minimal SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1350
lucas: SG. please define 'grace window' (one-liner) and mark fallback as opt-in. ops asked for a one-paragraph rationale and a short troubleshooting checklist.
mei: Ops checklist idea: 1) synthetic repro load command 2) check KV cache hit % 3) grep model-selection logs for 'fallback' tags. Keep it 3 bullets.
tay: adding a short "Known limitations" note: streaming may not be preserved when switching models mid-request; KV cache won't carry over.
lucas: SDK guidance: since we don't expose fallback_model in stable SDKs, show explicit retry + reissue. Keep snippets copy-paste tiny. PY example:
```python
try:
    resp = client.generate(model="big-llm", input=text)
except TooManyRequestsError:
    time.sleep(0.5)  # backoff/jitter omitted for brevity
    resp = client.generate(model="medium-llm", input=text)
```
JS example:
```js
try {
  const r = await client.generate({model: 'big-llm', input})
} catch (e) {
  await sleep(500)
  const r2 = await client.generate({model: 'medium-llm', input})
}
```
billing-bot: FYI: billing team to confirm whether tokens consumed by retries are billed at attempted model or final served model. Will post exact language shortly.
tay: adding a labeled "synthetic repro" command for support to reproduce 429s locally:
```bash
hey load -c 120 -n 300 "curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{\"model\":\"big-llm\",\"input\":\"ping\"}'"
```
lucas: add a tiny FAQ: "Should I enable fallback?" Answer: "Opt-in: use if latency SLOs are higher priority than peak model quality; test with your prompts."
preview-bot: PR #1350 created by tay. lint: OK; link-check queued; preview deployed at 2026-03-23T14:40:00Z.
billing-bot: Confirmed: tokens billed at the model the request was executed against. If a retry used a different model, billing reflects the final executed request(s). Recommend calling this out and advising metric checks.
tay: perfect. I'll merge after adding the billing sentence and the 3-bullet ops checklist. Thanks all :rocket:
